raw: {"triples": [{"subject": "Recursive Neural Networks", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphology", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "In this work, we use recursive neural networks, in a novel way to model morphology and its compositionality."}, {"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphemes", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Essentially, we treat each morpheme as a basic unit in the RNNs and construct representations for morphologically complex words on the fly from their morphemes."}, {"subject": "Models", "predicate": "uses", "object": "syntactic information", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "The detailed analysis in Section 6 reveals that our models can blend well syntactic information, i.e., the word structure, and the semantics in grouping related words."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "Models", "predicate": "uses", "object": "Word Representations", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "As our focus is in learning morphemic semantics, we do not start training from scratch, but rather, initialize our models with existing word representations."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "embeddings", "predicate": "evaluatedOn", "object": "WordSim-353 dataset", "object_type": "Dataset", "source_sentence": "we evaluate the quality of our morphologically-aware embeddings on the popular WordSim-353 dataset, WS353 for short."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological structures of words", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "The RNN explicitly models the morphological structures of words, i.e., the syntactic information, to learn morphemic compositional- ity."}, {"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "achieves", "object": "better word representations", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "This paper combines recursive neural networks (RNNs) and neural language models (NLMs) in a novel way to learn better word representations."}, {"subject": "Neural Language Models", "predicate": "uses", "object": "surrounding word contexts", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "The NLMs, on the other hand, utilize surrounding word contexts to provide further semantics to the learned morphemic representations."}, {"subject": "embeddings", "predicate": "achieves", "object": "outperform existing embeddings on word similarity tasks", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "our context-sensitive morphoRNN embeddings could significantly outperform existing embeddings on word similarity tasks for many datasets."}, {"subject": "analysis", "predicate": "uses", "object": "syntactic and semantic information", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Our analysis reveals that the model could blend well both the syntactic and semantic information in clustering related words."}]}
